subject: ARA
label: Grade 10
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 10 Arabic, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 4 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: Literature and poetry
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Literature and poetry', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: analyse a short text. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Literature and poetry' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: analyse a short text, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: حكمة: العلم نور والجهل ظلام. الكلمتان المتضادتان: نور وظلام. (Knowledge is light, ignorance is darkness; opposites: light and darkness.) Method: Model run for 'Literature and poetry'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Analyse a short text: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Read the short text I wrote. أَنَا النَّخْلَةُ، جُذُورِي فِي التُّرَابِ وَرَأْسِي فِي السَّمَاءِ. تَهُزُّنِي الرِّيحُ فَلَا أَسْقُطُ، وَأُعْطِي التَّمْرَ لِمَنْ يَمُرُّ بِي. [I am the palm tree, my roots in the soil and my head in the sky. The wind shakes me but I do not fall, and I give dates to whoever passes by.]

Step 2, Identify the theme. The palm stands for a person who is steadfast and generous. Write: يَرْمُزُ النَّصُّ بِالنَّخْلَةِ إِلَى الْإِنْسَانِ الصَّبُورِ الْكَرِيمِ. [The text uses the palm to symbolise the patient, generous person.] Support it with a quotation.

Step 3, Name the devices. تَشْخِيصٌ [personification]: the palm speaks as أَنَا. طِبَاقٌ [antithesis]: التُّرَابِ and السَّمَاءِ, the low and the high. اسْتِعَارَةٌ [metaphor]: the palm as the human being. Each device adds to the meaning.

Step 4, Write an analysis paragraph. يُبْرِزُ الْكَاتِبُ ثَبَاتَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ خِلَالِ عِبَارَةِ «جُذُورِي فِي التُّرَابِ وَرَأْسِي فِي السَّمَاءِ»، فَالطِّبَاقُ يُصَوِّرُ التَّوَاضُعَ مَعَ الطُّمُوحِ. [The writer highlights steadfastness through the phrase, roots in the soil and head in the sky; the contrast depicts humility with ambition.]

Step 5, Fix an error. A student only paraphrases: النَّخْلَةُ لَهَا جُذُورٌ وَتُعْطِي التَّمْرَ. Correction: analysis explains how and why: name the device, quote the words, and say what effect they create, such as showing generosity and strength.

Step 6, Your turn: analyse the line تَهُزُّنِي الرِّيحُ فَلَا أَسْقُطُ. Model answer: تَدُلُّ الْجُمْلَةُ عَلَى الْمُثَابَرَةِ؛ فَالرِّيحُ رَمْزٌ لِلصُّعُوبَاتِ، وَالنَّخْلَةُ لَا تَسْقُطُ كَالْإِنْسَانِ الصَّبُورِ. [The sentence shows perseverance; the wind symbolises difficulties, and the palm does not fall, like a patient person.]

modules.title: Formal letters
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Formal letters', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: write a formal letter. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Formal letters' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: write a formal letter, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: الرسالة: التاريخ، المرسل إليه، التحية (السلام عليكم ورحمة الله)، الموضوع، المتن، الخاتمة مع الشكر، التوقيع. Method: Model run for 'Formal letters'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Write a formal letter: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, A formal letter has a date, the addressee, a formal greeting, a body, a closing and a signature. Address: حَضْرَةِ الْأُسْتَاذِ مُدِيرِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ الْمُحْتَرَمِ. [To the respected school principal.] Greeting: تَحِيَّةً طَيِّبَةً وَبَعْدُ، [With best greetings, and then,].

Step 2, Write the opening of the body. أَتَقَدَّمُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِطَلَبٍ لِإِقَامَةِ مَعْرِضٍ لِلْكِتَابِ فِي الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ الْقَادِمِ. [I submit to you a request to hold a book fair at school next Thursday.] State the request in the first sentence.

Step 3, Give reasons and details. يَهْدِفُ الْمَعْرِضُ إِلَى تَشْجِيعِ الطُّلَّابِ عَلَى الْقِرَاءَةِ، وَسَيُشَارِكُ فِيهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ الْأُمُورِ. لِذَا أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِالْمُوَافَقَةِ. [The fair aims to encourage students to read, and parents will take part. I therefore ask you kindly to approve.]

Step 4, Close and sign. وَتَفَضَّلُوا بِقَبُولِ فَائِقِ الِاحْتِرَامِ وَالتَّقْدِيرِ. [Please accept my highest respect and appreciation.] مُقَدِّمُ الطَّلَبِ: خَالِدٌ، الصَّفُّ الْعَاشِرُ. [Applicant: Khalid, grade ten.] Keep the language polite and the sentences short.

Step 5, Fix an error. A student starts the letter with مَرْحَبًا يَا مُدِيرُ [Hello, principal], uses slang, and forgets the date. Correction: open with the formal address, تَحِيَّةً طَيِّبَةً وَبَعْدُ، write standard Arabic, and put the date at the top.

Step 6, Your turn: write the body of a letter asking permission to organise a charity day. Model answer: أَتَقَدَّمُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِطَلَبٍ لِتَنْظِيمِ يَوْمٍ خَيْرِيٍّ لِجَمْعِ التَّبَرُّعَاتِ. أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِالْمُوَافَقَةِ. وَتَفَضَّلُوا بِقَبُولِ الِاحْتِرَامِ. [I request permission to organise a charity day to collect donations. I kindly ask for approval. Please accept my respect.]

modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Listening and summary', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: summarise a spoken text. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.

Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: summarise a spoken text, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: أبدأ بالتحية، ثم أعرض ثلاث أفكار مع مثال، وأختم بالشكر. للتلخيص: أكتب الفكرة الرئيسية في جملتين. Method: Model run for 'Listening and summary'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Summarise a spoken text: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Listen to this announcement, which a partner reads once. تُعْلِنُ إِدَارَةُ الْمَدْرَسَةِ عَنْ إِقَامَةِ يَوْمٍ لِلنَّظَافَةِ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ الْقَادِمِ، وَسَيُشَارِكُ فِيهِ ثَلَاثُمِائَةِ طَالِبٍ. [The school administration announces a cleaning day next Sunday, with three hundred students taking part.]

Step 2, Hear the second half. سَيَبْدَأُ الْعَمَلُ فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ صَبَاحًا وَيَنْتَهِي عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ. عَلَى كُلِّ طَالِبٍ إِحْضَارُ قُفَّازَاتٍ وَكِيسٍ. [Work will start at nine in the morning and finish at noon. Each student must bring gloves and a bag.]

Step 3, Take notes while listening. Write key words only: يَوْمُ نَظَافَةٍ، الْأَحَدُ، 300 طَالِبٍ، 9 صَبَاحًا – ظُهْرًا، قُفَّازَاتٌ وَكِيسٌ. [cleaning day, Sunday, 300 students, 9 am to noon, gloves and bag.] Notes use words and numbers, not full sentences.

Step 4, Write the summary from your notes. أَعْلَنَتِ الْمَدْرَسَةُ عَنْ يَوْمِ نَظَافَةٍ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ، يُشَارِكُ فِيهِ ثَلَاثُمِائَةِ طَالِبٍ مِنَ التَّاسِعَةِ حَتَّى الظُّهْرِ، وَعَلَى كُلِّ طَالِبٍ إِحْضَارُ قُفَّازَاتٍ وَكِيسٍ. [The school announced a cleaning day on Sunday with three hundred students from nine until noon; each must bring gloves and a bag.]

Step 5, Fix an error. A student tries to write every word and loses the numbers and times. Correction: note who, what, when, how many and what to bring; leave out repeated words and add linking words only when writing the summary.

Step 6, Your turn: summarise a different announcement about a trip next Friday at eight, with fifty students, bringing lunch. Model answer: سَتَنْظِمُ الْمَدْرَسَةُ رِحْلَةً يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ الْقَادِمِ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ، وَيُشَارِكُ فِيهَا خَمْسُونَ طَالِبًا، وَعَلَى كُلِّ طَالِبٍ إِحْضَارُ غَدَاءٍ. [The school will organise a trip next Friday at eight, with fifty students; each must bring lunch.]

modules.title: Oral presentation
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Oral presentation', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: present on a topic. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Oral presentation' twice. You repeat them aloud.

modules.example: Solved: أبدأ بالتحية، ثم أعرض ثلاث أفكار مع مثال، وأختم بالشكر. للتلخيص: أكتب الفكرة الرئيسية في جملتين. Method: Model run for 'Oral presentation'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Present on a topic: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Open with a hook and a thesis. هَلْ فَكَّرْتُمْ يَوْمًا كَمْ لِتْرًا مِنَ الْمَاءِ نُهْدِرُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟ [Have you ever thought how many litres of water we waste each day?] مَوْضُوعِي الْيَوْمَ هُوَ أَهَمِّيَّةُ الْحِفَاظِ عَلَى الْمَاءِ. [My topic today is the importance of saving water.]

Step 2, Present the structure aloud. سَأَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةِ أُمُورٍ: أَوَّلًا أَسْبَابُ الْهَدْرِ، ثَانِيًا آثَارُهُ، وَثَالِثًا الْحُلُولُ. [I will talk about three things: first the causes of waste, second its effects, and third solutions.] Signposting helps listeners follow.

Step 3, Develop each point with an example. أَوَّلًا، يُهْدِرُ بَعْضُنَا الْمَاءَ حِينَ يَتْرُكُ الصُّنْبُورَ مَفْتُوحًا. [First, some of us waste water by leaving the tap open.] ثَانِيًا، يُؤَدِّي ذَلِكَ إِلَى نَقْصِ الْمَاءِ لِلْأَجْيَالِ الْقَادِمَةِ. [Second, this leads to a shortage for coming generations.]

Step 4, Give solutions and close. ثَالِثًا، يُمْكِنُنَا جَمْعُ مِيَاهِ الْأَمْطَارِ وَإِصْلَاحُ التَّسْرِيبِ. وَفِي الْخِتَامِ أَدْعُوكُمْ لِلْبَدْءِ الْيَوْمَ. شُكْرًا لِحُسْنِ اسْتِمَاعِكُمْ. [Third, we can collect rainwater and fix leaks. In conclusion I call on you to begin today. Thank you for your attention.]

Step 5, Fix an error. A speaker reads from the slides without looking up and gives no example. Correction: use only key words on the slides, speak to the audience, pause after each point, and add one example. Respond to questions with سُؤَالٌ وَجِيهٌ [a good question] before answering.

Step 6, Your turn: write a thirty-second introduction and thesis on screen time. Model answer: هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَ كَمْ سَاعَةً نَقْضِيهَا أَمَامَ الشَّاشَةِ؟ مَوْضُوعِي الْيَوْمَ أَثَرُ الْإِفْرَاطِ فِي اسْتِعْمَالِ الشَّاشَاتِ عَلَى صِحَّتِنَا. [Do you know how many hours we spend in front of the screen? My topic today is the effect of excessive screen use on our health.]
